purpose: Approximately twelve-hour single-GPU sequential campaign: domain-matched absolute versus differential EEG preservation and anchored native projection updates
matched_dimension_control: P_rel_random anchors a seeded random direction with the same norm and codimension as the actual EEG mean anchor
trainable_parameters: Only existing P.proj.weight: 8388608 parameters. P bias and LayerNorm affine frozen for all five arms. No added inference parameters.
objective: Existing v303 joint objective: positive noise MSE +0.1 token angle +visual replay +same-concept paired softplus, plus one domain-matched EEG preservation term with coefficient1
EEG_relative: 0.5*MSE((f_theta(c)-f_theta(c_wrong))-(f_0(c)-f_0(c_wrong))) at exactly the same z,t. The 0.5 matches expected scale for independent equal-variance drifts, not the realized gradient norm.
projection_constraint: mu=mean_T A(ordinary(c_OOF)), computed under original BF16 training coordinate; after each AdamW proposal, project displacement DeltaW onto DeltaW*mu=0 for real mean anchor, or DeltaW*q=0 for random anchor. Native bias/LN fixed. This is a classical affine-subspace constrained optimizer, not OFT or a new theorem.
sampling_and_permissions: Same T order/noise/t/negative-cycle/tau as completed v303. No D/V/R80 data for fitting, mean, epoch selection or control choice. Upstream EEG is OOF but ordinary has seen all T; whole pipeline is not OOF.
